title: Eleven Reports, One River
subtitle: 污染治理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 污染治理（环境保护·污染与治理）
meta: 主题语境：污染治理（环境保护·污染与治理）　|　核心词汇：problem　|　正文 321 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 problem 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① problem with the river was never that nobody knew about it; it was that everybody did. It had been reported eleven times between 1994 and 2003, and the reports are still in the file. The ② problem, as my father put it, was that a thing written about eleven times has been solved eleven times on paper by somebody else.

He had taught mathematics for thirty-one years, and he had a habit of setting the ③ problem to his old classes: eleven reports, eleven years, one river, and the water no cleaner. He said the children always ④ solved the problem in an hour, and always the same way, and that the answer they gave was the one nobody in the council had ever wanted.

There was a ⑤ problem with the pump at the treatment works in 2001, which is what the council called it: a mechanical ⑥ problem, a part, a delay. My father said the word does that job better than any other, because it turns a thing somebody decided into a thing that simply happened. He said the same word is used for a broken pipe and for a broken marriage, and that this is not an accident.

I have ⑦ no problem with the engineers, who were mostly honest; my ⑧ problem is with the minutes, which were not. My father had a ⑨ problem with the word itself by the end: he said a problem is something with an answer, and the river was something with a decision.

The river was cleaned in 2009, in eleven months, once somebody decided to. Eleven months is not a long time for a river, and it is a very long time for a family. My father did not live to see it. The ⑩ problem of who decides, which is the only problem the eleven reports never mention, is still with us, and I do not think it has an answer of the kind he meant.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 问题；难题；困难
B. n. 习题；（数学、逻辑的）题目
C. n. 故障；毛病（a problem with ...）
D. 固定搭配：no problem 没问题；不介意
E. 固定搭配：have a problem with sth. 对……有意见／难以接受
F. 固定搭配：solve / deal with a problem 解决／处理问题
G. n. （社会、环境等的）议题；问题（the problem of ...）
H. 固定搭配：the problem is that ... 问题在于……

items.q: The problem with the river was never that nobody knew
The problem, as my father put it, was that
setting the problem to his old classes
the children always solved the problem in an hour
There was a problem with the pump
a mechanical problem, a part, a delay
I have no problem with the engineers
my problem is with the minutes
My father had a problem with the word itself

answers.why: the problem with ... 意为“……的问题／毛病”，说河的问题不在于没人知道。
the problem is that ... 意为“问题在于……”，父亲说问题在于一件事被写了十一次就等于在纸上被解决了十一次。
problem 意为“习题、题目”，他习惯把这道题出给以前的学生。
solve the problem 意为“解出这道题／解决问题”，孩子们总在一小时内解出来。
a problem with ... 意为“……出了故障”，2001 年处理厂的水泵出了毛病。
a mechanical problem 意为“机械故障”，议会把它说成只是零件和延误。
no problem with ... 意为“对……没有意见、不介意”，我对那些工程师没有意见。
my problem is with ... 指“我（有意见）的是……”，此处仍取“问题、症结”义。
have a problem with sth. 意为“对某事有意见、难以接受”，父亲后来对“问题”这个词本身都有意见。
the problem of ... 意为“……这一议题／问题”，由谁来决定是十一份报告从未提到的问题。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 这条河的问题从来不是没人知道。（problem）
他习惯把这道题出给以前的学生。（set a problem）
孩子们总在一小时内解出这道题。（solve the problem）
2001 年处理厂的水泵出了故障。（a problem with）
我对那些工程师没有意见，他们大体上是诚实的。（no problem with）
由谁来决定这个问题，是那十一份报告从未提到的。（the problem of）
answers: The problem with the river was never that nobody knew about it.
He had a habit of setting the problem to his old classes.
The children always solved the problem in an hour.
There was a problem with the pump at the treatment works in 2001.
I have no problem with the engineers, who were mostly honest.
The problem of who decides is the only problem the eleven reports never mention.
